title: Add staggered dual-paired rational-center and bit producers (κ = 8.032517e-5 complex-only / 8.800233e-5 joint)
body:
## Summary

Supersedes #104 (`research/stopped-product-rational-centers`) and #107 (`research/reversed-rational-centers`) by replacing the binary-tree prefix/suffix schedules inside the $(h, d) = (24, 24)$ rational-center complex producer and the $h = 23$ positive-label bit producer with **staggered dual-paired linear-chain schedules** (`research/staggered-rational-centers`).

Both the **complex-only** bound (holding #104's frozen `stopped-product-bit-axis.json` and `parent.AB = 803380799 / 10^13` fixed) and the **joint** bound (regenerating both the $h=23$ positive-label bit producer and the $h=24$ rational-center complex producer from source through the unmodified C++ maximum-cardinality bipartite matchers) are verified in `research/staggered-rational-centers/verify.py`:

| Metric | PR #104 (`stopped-product-rational-centers`) | PR #107 (`reversed-rational-centers`) | This PR (Complex-Only) | This PR (Joint Bit + Complex) |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Complex height / degree $(h, d)$ | $(24, 24)$ | $(24, 24)$ | $(24, 24)$ | $(24, 24)$ |
| Complex addition gates $c$ | $47,796$ | $47,796$ | **$48,958$** | **$48,958$** |
| Complex non-output non-input gates $q$ | $6,958$ | $6,958$ | **$8,120$** | **$8,120$** |
| Complex matched pairs (`match_complex_general`) | $9,836$ | $9,836$ | **$18,038$** | **$18,038$** |
| Complex recursion roles $R = c + q - 2\cdot\text{matched}$ | $44,918$ | $44,918$ | **$39,040$** (**$-5,878$**) | **$39,040$** (**$-5,878$**) |
| Complex rank sum / $\ell$ | $976,842$ / $552$ | $975,786$ / $552$ | **$938,064$ / $552$** | **$938,064$ / $552$** |
| Certified complex floor $b$ | $7.798287495 \times 10^{-5}$ | $7.801725496 \times 10^{-5}$ | **$8.801801147 \times 10^{-5}$** | **$8.801801147 \times 10^{-5}$** |
| Bit $h=23$ roles $R_{\text{bit}} = c + q - 2\cdot\text{matched}$ | $38,776$ | $38,776$ | $38,776$ (inherited) | **$34,014$** (**$-4,762$**) |
| Certified bit saving $AB$ | $8.03380799 \times 10^{-5}$ | $8.03380799 \times 10^{-5}$ | $8.03380799 \times 10^{-5}$ | **$8.921551719638 \times 10^{-5}$** |
| **Headline certified saving $\kappa$** | **$7.7950234824805 \times 10^{-5}$** | **$7.7984487412405 \times 10^{-5}$** | **$8.0325171150015 \times 10^{-5}$** | **$8.8002329264725 \times 10^{-5}$** |

- **Complex-only gain**: $+2.374936 \times 10^{-6}$ ($+3.05\%$) above PR #104 and $+2.340684 \times 10^{-6}$ ($+3.00\%$) above PR #107.
- **Joint regenerated gain**: $+1.005210 \times 10^{-5}$ ($+12.90\%$) above PR #104 and $+1.001784 \times 10^{-5}$ ($+12.85\%$) above PR #107.

## Key Mechanisms

1. **Staggered Dual-Paired Prefix/Suffix Strip Schedules (`StaggeredPairedTriple`)**:
   - At even indices $i$, `prefix` advances via paired sums `add(prefix[-2], add(values[i-1], values[i]))`; at odd indices $i$, `suffix` advances via paired sums `add(suffix[-2], add(values[n-1-i], values[n-i]))`.
   - Every intermediate gate in a paired step has one fan-in at odd distance and one fan-in at even distance in the linear chain, making all paired partial sums eligible under `match_complex_general.cpp` (`non_overlap`, `valid_S`, `valid_T`) and `match_positive_dag.cpp`.
   - At the top level of `two[u,v]` (`len(values) == 11`, `len(vals) == 10`), keeping `prefix` unpaired while pairing `suffix` at odd indices $i \in \{1, 3, 5, 7\}$ preserves all 10 `suffix[i]` nodes in `lookup[s]` (so `pre[2], pre[4], \dots, pre[20]` in `complex.py` hit `lookup` with zero duplicate gates) while matching `(suffix[2m], suffix[2m-1])` via `suffix[2m+1]` and `q_m = add(vals[2m-1], vals[2m])` into `prefix[2m+1]` via `vals[2m]`.

2. **Linear-Chain Block, Coarse, and Coefficient Aggregations (`rtotal`)**:
   - Replaces balanced binary trees in `block`, `coarse`, and `coeff` with reverse linear fold `rtotal` while keeping binary-tree `total` inside `result[excluded]` so 1-, 2-, and 3-survivor inclusion-exclusion partial sums remain shared.

3. **Leave-One-Pair-Out Readout Bridge & Same-Group Pair-Star Prefix Pairing**:
   - In `complex.py` (`StaggeredComplexProducer`), when `(a ^ 1) != b` and `2 <= j < 18` and `(i // 2 < a // 2 or (j // 2) % 2 == 0)`, `missing[p][q]` is assembled via the leave-one-pair-out bridge `add(add(pre[jj], suf[jj + 2]), w[jj ^ (1 - (j & 1))])` (`jj = j & ~1`), aligning with the odd-step suffix pairs from `two[u,v]` and eliminating 680 high-rank gates.
   - For the 12 same-group pair stars `(a ^ 1) == b` (skipped by `two[u,v]`), pairing `pre` at odd `idx_w < 20` reuses `add(w[idx_w-1], w[idx_w])` from `suf` via `lookup` with zero extra gates and adds 54 matched pairs.

## Verification

```bash
python3 -B research/staggered-rational-centers/verify.py
python3 -B research/staggered-rational-centers/test_controls.py
python3 -B research/reversed-rational-centers/verify.py
python3 -B research/reversed-rational-centers/test_controls.py
```
